summary: Library: the right pane opens with a selected paper and closes like the graph pane (the list takes the whole width while closed); 在论文关系图中定位 centres the paper even in a laid-out graph and keeps it centred when the graph box changes size; the list sorts by date saved, publication date or title, remembered on this computer.

budget_impact.rationale: Presentation only: CSS, list ordering and graph camera in the browser. No model call, network or stored data change (the sort choice lives in localStorage).
budget_impact.before: pane column always reserved in the list; a located paper could land outside the graph; list in stored order
budget_impact.after: pane like the graph pane; located paper centred; five list orders

additional_checks.scope: 543 Node tests including the new pane, centring and sorting tests

open_risks: Checked in Chromium on a synthetic library, not in WebKit (the macOS app engine) or the owner's real library.
Title order puts Latin titles A–Z before Chinese titles by pinyin; a different mixed order would be a one-line change.
